svg.text: Algorithm C.2. Image-Only Retrieval with Hard Category Filtering
Input: query image I; catalog images and categories; result count K
Output: ranked products from the selected category
1 Encode I with the fine-tuned CLIP vision encoder.
2 Compute S_II(q,p_i) against every catalog image.
3 Group visual neighbour scores by category; retain a balanced top set.
4 Compare the query image with CLIP category prompt embeddings.
5 Combine visual and prompt evidence; select the highest category c_hat.
6 Calculate category confidence for diagnostics only.
7 Keep products whose category equals c_hat.
8 If the user selected an audience, intersect with that audience group.
9 Rank eligible products by S_II(q,p_i) and return the first K.
Note: A low confidence value does not disable the hard category filter.
